query: Given this restaurant opening hours string: 12:00 PM - 3:00 PM, 6:00 PM - 10:00 PM, open on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays. Determine if the restaurant is generally open for dinner hours (around 19:00-22:00) on most days. Respond with open_for_dinner True if open during dinner most days, else False.
